assistant.subtitle: Ask any farming question in Kinyarwanda or English.
assistant.welcome: Hello! I'm the IHUTE assistant. Ask me about pests, diseases, fertilizer or planting.

suggestions.armyworm: How do I control fall armyworm?
suggestions.blight: My potato leaves are going black

answers.armyworm:
Fall armyworm (nkongwa) eats young maize leaves and leaves sawdust-like droppings.
• Check 20 plants across your field twice a week.
• Crush egg masses and young larvae by hand.
• If more than 1 in 5 plants is damaged, ask your officer which approved product to use.
answers.blight:
Black, spreading patches on potato leaves after rain are often late blight.
• Remove and bury affected leaves.
• Don't water the leaves.
• Send a photo with "Report a problem" so an officer can confirm and advise on spraying.
answers.fertilizer: For maize, many farmers use DAP at planting and Urea when plants are knee high. Exact amounts depend on your soil, so ask your officer or the RAB soil test service.
answers.planting: In most of Rwanda, beans are planted at the start of Season A (September) and Season B (February–March). Plant when the rains are steady.
answers.fallback: Thanks for your question. I've noted it for your local officer, who can give you a precise answer. For a sick plant, use "Report a problem" and add a photo.
